Colours

Dark sky. One clear signal.

Ink-first surfaces, warm white type and teal as the lead accent. Five supporting accents carry meaning, never decoration alone. Every ratio on this page is calculated from the hex values when the site is built.

Principles

Four rules for using colour.

  • 01

    Ink first

    Surfaces are Ink, Ink 2, Card and Lift. Pure black and pure white are not brand colours.

  • 02

    One lead accent

    Teal leads: links, buttons, the wordmark. Use one accent per component, and let the rest carry roles.

  • 03

    Colour plus a word

    Status and category are always written out. Colour is never the only signal.

  • 04

    Test the real pairing

    Check hover states, overlays and transparency. The matrix below is a starting point, not a licence.

Light backgrounds

Where the palette runs out.

The brand is dark-first. On Warm White the best accent reaches only 2.26:1 , so no accent meets even the 3:1 graphics threshold.

For light documents:

  • Set text in Ink (15.9:1 on Warm White, 19.1:1 on white).
  • Use an accent only as a fill with Ink text on top, for example Ink on Teal at 8.46:1.
  • Never use an accent as text, a thin line or an icon on a light background.
